method: Each Japanese target row read individually; English authored from source after learning from reference candidates. Equivalent full/short variants share prose deliberately. DLC flags preserved per source. Existing Movement +1. retained. Full prose drafted before line wrapping.

skills.453c11df31bf7b55ef27: Preserves the stated Morale <=100 condition for Daunt; does not replace it with a stronger below-100 floor claim.
skills.74761239b4e92983e284: Same Daunt condition as the full source description.
skills.dc6e448e0eb7e7af7b53: Uses the established Dash interpretation: +2 total at Morale 130+, not +1 plus +2.
skills.a539f4e9fd5d66a4aa38: Uses the established Dash interpretation: +2 total at Morale 130+, not +1 plus +2.
skills.41a875cb12545f83d884: Source says an enemy fought, not only an enemy hit; repair waiver checks presence when costs are settled.
skills.70c264d2aee00932c620: Source says an enemy fought, not only an enemy hit; repair waiver checks presence when costs are settled.
skills.c23f89a31f5c7693861f: Source full view states Morale 140; abbreviated view 127 states 120. Both thresholds retained pending gameplay/code verification.
skills.d9dbfec6664198f4f89e: Source abbreviated view states Morale 120; full view 126 states 140. Both thresholds retained pending gameplay/code verification.
skills.515dc6f0f7ab972a9fc3: Source says all main pilots in the team; the short view refers to the main pilot. Team/main/sub scope retained per view.
skills.e185759240aba50fa900: Source short view refers to the main pilot, unlike the full view all-main-pilots wording.

parts.a29c02d109c63fd0633e: 1200-damage barrier wording retains the stated strength without asserting the exact boundary comparison, which needs mechanic verification.
parts.27146dedbb8c97d5df11: Same D-Fault boundary caveat as the non-DLC row.
parts.f2fc790f16cc520ecb93: All units in an allied team, not every allied team. Source does not explicitly distinguish the owner team from a selectable allied team.
parts.d8f3404f1be70e3af8d9: This source view assigns rewards to main pilot, while other views separately name team funds/Z-Chips. Source wording retained.
parts.99468c098fe2bf93cc3a: This source is a distinct Tag Tension MAX-at-1 effect despite a Commander Lv4 reference candidate. Translated source, not candidate.

followup_reviews.source_review: All 50 Japanese source descriptions and original English checked before abbreviation. Morale thresholds, scope, range exclusions, effects and DLC restrictions retained. Existing source inconsistencies and uncertainty notes preserved.
followup_reviews.method: Greedy word wrapping with exact raster() advances; skills budget 845 units and parts 617 units, at most 3 lines. No condensed glyphs.
